appraise.en: Young people are also worried about how people will appraise them, which means judge them.
appraise.zh: 年轻人还担心别人会如何评估（appraise）他们，也就是评判他们。

appraise.en: And if you appraise someone, you judge them.
appraise.zh: 如果你去“appraise”某人，意思就是你对他们做出评估或评判。

appreciate.en: I appreciate your qualification, and you phrased it better than I did just now.
appreciate.zh: 我很欣赏你这个补充说明，而且你刚才表达得比我更贴切。

appreciate.en: The idea was simple: if something smelled heavenly, it was probably appreciated by the heavens.
appreciate.zh: 这个想法很简单：如果某种东西闻起来像天堂一样香，那么神灵可能也会喜欢。

appreciate.en: If you take something for granted, you fail to value or appreciate something which benefits you.
appreciate.zh: 如果你把某事视为理所当然，你就会忽视或不感激对你有益的事情。

appreciate.en: Women tend to especially appreciate men who do these kinds of chores.
appreciate.zh: 女性往往特别感激做这类家务的男性。

appreciate.en: Exactly. Just taking the time to really appreciate some of those small wins.
appreciate.zh: 完全正确。只要花时间真正去欣赏那些微小的胜利。

approve.en: Eventually, the Constitution was ratified, was approved, and in 1789, the new government began operating.
approve.zh: 最终，宪法得到了批准，并在1789年，新政府开始运作。

approve.en: Micheal was well disposed to the boy – he liked and approved of him.
approve.zh: Michael对这个男孩很有好感——他喜欢并认可他。

approve.en: Actually that pulse thing, also optional, like this case in Ohio, where 23 dead people were approved for mortgages.
approve.zh: 事实上，心跳这东西也是可选的，就像俄亥俄州的这个案例一样，23 个死人被批准了抵押贷款。

approve.en: In 2016, the UK approved a nuclear power station called Hinkley Point C, in the south-west of England.
approve.zh: 2016年，英国批准了位于英格兰西南部的一座名为 Hinkley Point C 的核电站。

approve.en: And he was under pressure to approve more and more loans.
approve.zh: 而且他承受着批准越来越多的贷款的压力。

appetite.en: And finally, appetite control is how your brain decides how much you should eat.
appetite.zh: 最后，appetite control是你的大脑决定你应该吃多少的方式。

appetite.en: If there’s an appetite for something, there’s a strong desire or demand for it.
appetite.zh: 如果对某事有 appetite（渴望），说明有强烈的欲望或需求。

appetite.en: Appetite control is where your brain decides how much you should eat.
appetite.zh: Appetite control是指你的大脑决定你应该吃多少。

appetite.en: It was unbelievable. I mean, we almost couldn't produce enough to keep the appetite of our investors happy.
appetite.zh: 这简直难以置信。我的意思是，我们几乎无法生产足够多的产品来满足投资者高涨的胃口。

appetite.en: And we have got to find a way to become his sole provider of bonds, of mortgage bonds, to fill his appetite.
appetite.zh: 而我们必须想方设法成为他唯一的债券供应商，供应抵押贷款债券，以满足他的胃口。

approach.en: This is why communicative and task-based approaches to learning English have become really popular.
approach.zh: 这就是为什么以交际和任务为基础的英语学习方法变得非常受欢迎的原因。

approach.en: The government has used these categories as part of its approach to managing diversity.
approach.zh: 政府将这些类别作为其管理多元化方法的一部分。

approach.en: Because these two approaches are quite different, they can be used together and individually.
approach.zh: 由于这两种方法截然不同，它们既可以结合使用，也可以单独使用。

approach.en: Prioritizing skills and employment is practical and measurable, but this approach also creates tension.
approach.zh: 优先考虑技能和就业是务实且可衡量的，但这种方法也带来了紧张局势。

approach.en: Marie’s approach to research involved measuring tiny amounts of radiation emitted by different substances.
approach.zh: 玛丽的研究方法涉及测量不同物质发射的微量辐射。

apply.en: The phrase, one-size-fits-all, describes trying to apply the same solution to many different problems.
apply.zh: “一刀切”这个短语描述的是试图将相同的解决方案应用于许多不同的问题。

apply.en: Britain became the pioneer of mass production, and this was applied to food as well.
apply.zh: 英国成为了大规模生产的先驱，这也应用到了食品领域。

apply.en: In January, Donald Trump banned 75 countries from applying for visas to the USA.
apply.zh: 在一月份，唐纳德·特朗普禁止了75个国家的公民申请美国签证。

apply.en: Apply language immediately. Don’t wait until you feel ready to use new words or grammar.
apply.zh: 立即应用语言。不要等到你觉得自己准备好了才去使用新单词或新语法。

apply.en: He writes. Does he apply that to like other elements of making a song though?
apply.zh: 他写歌。但他会把这种劲头用到制作歌曲的其他环节吗？

appreciation.en: He returned from France with an appreciation for French food and French culture.
appreciation.zh: 他从法国归来时，对法国食物和法国文化十分欣赏。

appreciation.en: I think all you can do is kind of cultivate an appreciation and gratitude for what you have.
appreciation.zh: 我认为你所能做的就是培养对你所拥有的东西的欣赏和感激。

appreciation.en: Etiquette varies a lot over time and culture, but the essential point is always to show appreciation by doing some things and avoiding others.
appreciation.zh: 礼仪随着时代和文化的不同而有很大差异，但核心点始终是通过做某些事情和避免做其他事情来表达感激之情。

appreciation.en: For this group of students, showing respect and appreciation for the meal is very important, and this idea is common across most, if not all, cultures throughout history.
appreciation.zh: 对于这群学生来说，对这顿饭表现出尊重和感激是非常重要的，这种观念在历史上大多数（如果不是全部）文化中都很普遍。

appreciation.en: So, yeah, I mean, there was something about this absolute lack of appreciation of what the possibilities would be that allowed them to bring together the resources in a way that in a regulated environment would be very difficult.
appreciation.zh: 所以，是啊，我是说，正是因为当时完全没人意识到其中蕴藏的可能性，才让他们得以以一种在受严格监管的环境里根本难以实现的方式，把各种资源整合到了一起。

approximately.en: Your lawyer tells you to expect your case to come to court in approximately three years.
approximately.zh: 你的律师告诉你，你的案子大概要等上三年左右才能开庭。

approximately.en: So, approximately how many people work in call centres globally, Phil?
approximately.zh: 那么，Phil，全球大约有多少人在呼叫中心工作？

approximately.en: It didn’t take long for people to realise that the cycle of the seasons repeated approximately every 365 days.
approximately.zh: 人们没花多久就意识到，季节的周期大约每 365 天重复一次。

approximately.en: The number of exactly two litres isn't based on scientific fact, it's more of a ballpark figure – a number which is a guess, but which you still believe is approximately correct.
approximately.zh: 刚好两升这个数字并不是基于科学事实，它更像是一个“ballpark figure”（大致数字）——一个虽是猜测但你仍认为大致正确的数字。

approximately.en: In other words, yes, you might think of a rocket blasting off into space and think, “Well, that must be very environmentally unfriendly”, but it is approximately 700 times better for the environment than the way we currently do it.
approximately.zh: 换句话说，是的，你可能会想到火箭呼啸着飞向太空，然后觉得“嗯，这一定很不环保”，但它对环境的友好程度大约是我们目前开采方式的 700 倍。

appeal.en: Ultimately, he first sues the government--and loses--and then he appeals to the Supreme Court.
appeal.zh: 最终，他先是起诉了政府——败诉了——然后又上诉到最高法院。

appeal.en: For many voters in the UK, the emotional appeal outweighed the actual truth.
appeal.zh: 对于英国的许多选民来说，情感诉求胜过了真正的真相。

appeal.en: Where does it come from? Does it appeal to emotion more than evidence?
appeal.zh: 它来自哪里？它是不是比证据更诉诸于情感？

appeal.en: He appeals to the Supreme Court on constitutional basis.
appeal.zh: 他以宪法为依据向最高法院上诉。

appeal.en: There is also the argument that the style of the show, what was happening on stage, was simply losing its appeal.
appeal.zh: 还有一个论点是，该节目的风格，也就是舞台上正在发生的事情，正在失去吸引力。

applaud.en: He has outlived the king who first applauded him in 1662.
applaud.zh: 他比 1962 年第一个为他鼓掌的国王活得还要久。

appoint.en: Second, and perhaps more importantly, he was appointed Chief of the Royal Court.
appoint.zh: 其次，或许也是更重要的是，他被任命为王室法院主管（办公厅主任）。

appoint.en: The answer is about power. A judge is appointed by the state.
appoint.zh: 答案关乎权力。法官是由国家任命的。

appoint.en: His eldest son, the future George IV, was appointed Prince Regent to govern in his place.
appoint.zh: 他的长子、未来的 George IV 被任命为摄政王代行统治。

appoint.en: As town marshal, he could appoint deputies, and he hired family.
appoint.zh: 作为镇治安官，他有权任命副手，于是他雇用了自己的家人。

appoint.en: In 1998, he was appointed head of the Federal Security Service, or FSB, the successor to the KGB.
appoint.zh: 1998年，他被任命为联邦安全局（即FSB，KGB的继承者）局长。

approval.en: And so that's when I was like, maybe his approval isn't the right way to feel good about life.
approval.zh: 所以就在那时我想，也许他的认可并不是对生活感觉良好的正确方式。

approval.en: The agreement to publish the manifesto, made with the full approval of the FBI, was a sign of desperation.
approval.zh: 同意发表这份宣言，是在得到 FBI 全力批准的情况下做出的，这是一个绝望的信号。

approval.en: There's a real draw of being swayed by social approval.
approval.zh: 受社会认可所左右有着极大的吸引力。

approval.en: Some polls pegged his approval rating as low as 30%.
approval.zh: 一些民意调查显示他的支持率低至 30%。

approval.en: And so like his approval was literally everything.
approval.zh: 所以他的认可简直就是一切。

apparent.en: And the main opposition, or rather, the main apparent opposition, was the Muslim Brotherhood.
apparent.zh: 而主要的反对派，或者说主要的表面反对派，是穆斯林兄弟会（Muslim Brotherhood）。

apparent.en: Now, Denard was not especially ideological, as will become apparent.
apparent.zh: 正如接下来大家会看到的，Bob Denard 并没有特别强烈的意识形态。

apparent.en: And it was so like the feeling of that, I think at that age, maybe wasn't apparent for me.
apparent.zh: 那种感觉，我想在那个年纪，对我来说可能并不明显。

apparent.en: The apparent resilience, and I say apparent because I don't know how to define the perseverance in the face of so many struggles, other than using the word resilience is astounding.
apparent.zh: 那种明显的韧性，我说‘明显’是因为我不知道如何定义在这么多挣扎面前的毅力，除了使用‘韧性’这个词，是令人震惊的。

appropriate.en: Over time, you will develop a natural sense of what’s appropriate or what’s not appropriate.
appropriate.zh: 随着时间的推移，你将对什么得体、什么不得体培养出一种自然的语感。

appropriate.en: Over time, you will develop a natural sense of what’s appropriate or what’s not appropriate.
appropriate.zh: 随着时间的推移，你将对什么得体、什么不得体培养出一种自然的语感。

appropriate.en: Yeah, they should make their own mistakes and learn their own lessons and have their own desires and fulfill them as is appropriate.
appropriate.zh: 是的，他们应该自己犯错，自己吸取教训，拥有自己的愿望并适当地去实现它们。

appropriate.en: It was happening in real time. And I think when we began this conversation, sure, students wanted change, but many other people quite reasonably made the argument that a facing history was not appropriate.
appropriate.zh: 事情是实时发生、不断演进的。我想，当我们刚开始这场讨论时，学生们固然想要改变，但也有很多人相当合理地提出，直面历史并不意味着一定要改名。

appropriate.en: Guilty, or not guilty. The judge's job is to oversee the proceedings, to advise the jury on points of law, and if the verdict comes back guilty, they will decide on the appropriate punishment, based on the severity of the crime.
appropriate.zh: 有罪，或者无罪。法官的职责是主持整个庭审程序，就法律要点向陪审团提供指导，如果最终裁决为有罪，法官则会根据罪行的严重程度决定相应的量刑。

application.en: They receive thousands of applications and have to decide who gets accepted.
application.zh: 他们收到数千份申请，必须决定谁能被录取。

application.en: Get some leverage, try to find some practical application of it and go into that.
application.zh: 获得一些杠杆，尝试找到它的实际应用，然后投入其中。

application.en: I have used a website called Replit and also the AI site Claude to create applications.
application.zh: 我曾使用过一个叫做Replit的网站以及AI网站Claude来创建应用程序。

application.en: And not every AI application will generate a profit.
application.zh: 并非每个AI应用都能产生利润。

application.en: In 1936, he published a paper with a long and technical title: “On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem.
application.zh: 1936 年，他发表了一篇标题又长又专业的论文：《论可计算数及其在判定问题中的应用》。

appointment.en: She schedules and screens appointments for other sex workers in Tucson, Arizona.
appointment.zh: 她在亚利桑那州图森市为其他性工作者安排和筛选预约。

appointment.en: Putin’s appointment came at a chaotic time for Russia.
appointment.zh: Putin的上台正值俄罗斯局势混乱的时期。

appointment.en: Does this story of what happened at Burton connect to any of the concerns you have about her appointment as Education Secretary?
appointment.zh: 在Burton发生的故事，是否与你对她被任命为教育部长所抱有的任何担忧有关？

appealing.en: When you would visit those websites, that is appealing to a thing that is intrinsically you.
appealing.zh: 当你浏览这些网站时，它在呼唤着你骨子里的本能。

appealing.en: Suddenly, the idea of an alternative energy source, one that didn’t depend on oil and seemed almost limitless, became extremely appealing.
appealing.zh: 突然之间，一种不依赖石油、且看似几乎取之不尽的替代能源的想法变得极其具有吸引力。

appealing.en: But what makes these asteroids so appealing isn’t just their high metal content—it’s that the metals are often much more accessible than on Earth.
appealing.zh: 但这些小行星如此吸引人的地方，不仅仅是因为它们的高金属含量——而是因为这些金属往往比地球上的更容易获取。

appendix.en: The belief was somehow that our emotions were vestigial, meaning, yes, they're part of our animal heritage, just like our wisdom teeth, just like our appendices.
appendix.zh: 这种信念在某种程度上认为，我们的情绪是一种“退化的遗迹”——也就是说，没错，它们是我们动物性遗产的一部分，就像我们的智齿，就像我们的阑尾一样。

appendix.en: What do I think is ignored by the media but will be studied by historians? well i mean the media is only focused on very timely things right so it depends if you want to talk about timely or timeless right but as a simple example if i just look at things that maybe the next five or ten years that are going to make a massive difference that people are not focused enough on um and i think within two years this will be obvious so like the then i make a prediction and predictions are tough but you're gonna have to eat it in a few yeah i'm gonna have to eat this in a few years so i'm probably wrong but uh two things that i pay attention to um that i don't think uh a lot of people do pay attention to well there's a couple one is i think just how bad modern medicine is i think people just put a lot more faith in modern medicine than is warranted like our best ideas for a lot of things are surgery just cutting things out right uh treating things that are extraneous like oh you don't really need a gallbladder you You don't really need an appendix.
appendix.zh: 你问我什么事被媒体忽视但会被历史学家研究？嗯，媒体只关注非常时效性的事情，所以这取决于你是想谈论时效性的还是永恒的话题。举个简单的例子，如果我只看未来五到十年内会产生巨大影响，但人们关注度不够的事情……嗯，我觉得两年内这就会变得显而易见。所以，如果我要做一个预测——预测很难，而且几年后我可能得为自己的话负责——所以我很可能是错的。但我关注的两件事，我觉得没多少人关注。其中之一是现代医学有多糟糕。我觉得人们对现代医学的信任远超其应有的程度。我们处理很多问题的最佳方案就是手术，就是把东西切掉，处理那些所谓多余的部分，比如‘哦，你其实不需要胆囊，你不需要阑尾’。

applicable.en: That my particular mental makeup or life situation or historical wounds or dreams for the future render me immune to these lessons being applicable.
applicable.zh: 我特殊的心理构成、生活状况、历史创伤或对未来的梦想，使我免于这些课程的适用。

applicable.en: And then I started reading the words and you realize that it's both applicable and powerful to a young person, but also something you could read alone at my age of 32.
applicable.zh: 然后我开始读文字，你就会意识到它既适用于年轻人，也是一本像我这样32岁的人可以独自阅读的书。

apt.en: So I guess it goes to the now sort of cliche, but still, I think, very apt phrase.
apt.zh: 我想这归结于那句老生常谈，但我认为依然非常贴切的话。
